artworks.title: Baptism of the Prince of Spain [verso]
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 18.4 cm (5 1/8 × 7 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial scene with a central focus on a robed figure standing before a large basin. The drawing depicts a gathering of figures dressed in elaborate, historical attire. The central robed figure stands with hands over the basin. Surrounding them are individuals dressed in richly detailed garments. The composition is framed by large columns draped with fabric. The line work and shading bring out the details in the clothing and the architectural elements. The style suggests a historical or religious significance to the event being depicted.

artworks.title: King and Queen in Consultation about the Turks [recto]
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.5 × 18 cm (5 5/16 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a group of elaborately dressed individuals sitting under a canopy. The figures wear ruffled collars typical of a specific historical period. In the foreground, one person stands while the seated individuals listen. In the background, people holding spears follow a drummer. Architectural elements like columns and a balustrade add to the grandiose atmosphere. The intricate line work suggests a technique such as etching or engraving, commonly used for detailed historical or narrative illustrations.

artworks.title: Philip as a Boy Before Margaret of Austria [verso]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.5 × 18 cm (5 5/16 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a ceremonial gathering. The scene depicts a group of figures in historical attire gathered near a grand architectural setting. In the center, a bishop wearing a mitre is performing what appears to be a ceremonial act, as a child is being presented wrapped in ornate cloth. Surrounding the main figures are other people dressed in period costumes, characterized by ruffled collars and capes. The architectural features in the background include arches and a domed structure. The details in this ink drawing capture the grandeur and solemnity of the occasion being portrayed, offering insight into the ceremonial practices and attire of the period.

artworks.title: A Capucin bringing thanks of the King of Bavaria [recto]
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 18.2 cm (5 1/8 × 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures in a historical setting, with interactions suggesting intrigue or a narrative scene. The figures are adorned in elaborate, period-specific attire. A central figure on the left wears clothing indicative of high status, with ornate details and a sword, interacting with a similarly dressed figure. To the right, a figure clad in robes gestures as if in conversation or negotiation. The background includes architectural elements like arches and detailed walls, creating a sense of depth and environment. The composition evokes themes of historical drama and social interaction, capturing a moment for viewers to contemplate its meaning and context.

artworks.title: The Queen Laying the First Stone for the Church of the Poor Clares in Spain [verso]
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 18.2 cm (5 1/8 × 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a group scene set in a historical context. Several full-body figures are engaged in various activities. At the center, a person in an elaborate gown stands with hands about waist-high, possibly receiving an object from a kneeling figure offering a platter. This central figure wears a decorative dress with ornate detailing, including a high ruff and a long necklace, and their hair appears styled in an updo with adornments. Around this individual, others are positioned—some standing and some kneeling. On the left, a figure wearing a mitre and ecclesiastical robes gestures towards the central person. A hooded figure stands in the backdrop. In the background are buildings with architectural elements typical of European towns, and workers in simple garments are active with tools.

artworks.title: Reception of the Envoy of Poland [recto]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.1 × 18 cm (5 3/16 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person in a regal position on a throne elevated by a platform. The person sitting has delicate facial features, and their hair appears styled elaborately, perhaps with a crown or headpiece. They wear a long garment adorned with intricate details and jewelry, including a large necklace. Around them, several figures are standing in a semi-circle, with different facial features and hairstyles. Most are dressed in robes or tunics with ornate patterns, and some wear ruffled collars. One standing figure kneels in front of the throne, extending their hand toward the seated person. The background includes a draped curtain and architectural details, creating a formal and grand ambiance of a court or chamber.

artworks.title: The Envoy of Tuscany thanking the Queen [verso]
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.1 × 18 cm (5 3/16 × 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures wearing period clothing. A central seated figure is facing right, wearing a large ruffled collar and a voluminous dress with detailed sleeves. To their left, a standing figure with a ruffled collar is gesturing towards the group on the right. Another figure on the right is standing and holding a document, addressing the seated figure. Additional figures in period attire with ruffled collars and puffed sleeves are positioned at varying angles in the background. The setting seems to be indoors, with a textured pattern on the wall or drapery and a step leading to the seated figure's position.

artworks.title: Death of the Queen
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 17.2 cm (5 1/8 × 6 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures in a room. Some figures are kneeling or standing around a bed. The figures wear long robes and some have hoods or collars. One figure lies in the bed, covered by a blanket and holding a large cross. The figures around the bed appear to be praying or keeping vigil. Above them, there are cherub-like figures in the cloud formation. The room is decorated with curtains, a hanging lantern, and a table with a pitcher on it.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot after Andrea del Sarto
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting four figures in a circular composition. Each figure is shown from the waist up. In the center, two young children are seated and facing forward. The child on the left has curly hair, and the child on the right appears to be holding something. To the left and right of the children are two women who seem to be caregivers. The woman on the left is shown in profile wearing a head covering and a long-sleeved garment. She looks towards the other woman while holding the child. The woman on the right is slightly turned towards the viewer, also dressed in flowing garments and a head covering, and appears to hold the other child. Behind the woman on the left, an older man with a bearded face and serious expression looks over the group. He wears a head scarf and holds a staff. The background features a simple engraved texture, and the scene is enclosed within a circular frame. Below the circle, there is a section with a coat of arms and some text.

artworks.title: The Holy Family
artworks.artist: Jacques Callot after Andrea del Sarto
artworks.description: The image is a detailed etching depicting a group of four people within a circular frame. The figures are shown from the waist up. In the center, there is a young woman sitting, looking slightly to her right. She has delicate facial features and is wearing a headscarf. Next to her, two small, curly-haired children are present, with one child sitting on the lap of the seated woman. The child on her lap is facing to the side, and the other child is standing while facing forward. On the far left, an elderly man with a beard appears to be leaning forward, partially included in the frame. The figures are draped in cloth garments. The background consists of intricate linework and a round, decorative border enclosing the group. Below the circular illustration, there is text and a coat of arms.

artworks.title: The Holy Family with Two Angels
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing a seated woman with a child on her lap, surrounded by three angels and a bearded man. The woman's full body is depicted, sitting on a draped surface, with the child sitting up and being embraced. The woman has long hair covered by a cloth that extends down her back. The child appears to have curly hair. The woman is draped in flowing garments that cover her body, and the child is depicted nude. The man's face is partially turned away, showing a prominent nose and curly beard. He is clothed in a draped garment as well. One angel shows only their head and wings, while the other two angels show full bodies, identifiable by their wings, and are playing musical instruments—one plays a stringed instrument while the other a woodwind. There is no prominent jewelry in the scene. The background consists of vertical lines and includes an elaborately draped fabric at the top.

artworks.title: Ecce Homo
artworks.description: The image shows a shirtless man standing in the center wearing a crown of thorns and a cloth around his waist. On his sides are men in robes, with one gesturing towards him. A crowd of people in historical clothing is gathered in the foreground below, looking upward. The background features columns, clouds in the sky, and a distant cityscape.

artworks.title: Painting of the Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.4 × 8.4 cm (5 1/4 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with multiple figures engaging in a religious activity. The setting is an architectural interior, possibly a workshop or chapel. A group of people are gathered below a slightly elevated area where an angel is speaking to a seated figure. The figures below are engaged in various activities, some gesturing towards the elevated scene while others observe with interest. The architectural details include windows, columns, and a draped cloth. A small dog is seen in the foreground. The text at the bottom indicates it may be an illustrated narrative related to religious or historical storytelling.

artworks.title: The Child
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8 cm (5 1/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows two women and a baby. The first woman is sitting in a bed holding a candle, while the second woman is standing beside the bed reaching towards the baby. The baby is in an ornate cradle with a protective figure above it. The background includes curtains and fabric folds. In the top right corner, there is a scene with a haloed figure seated on a cloud, with another figure kneeling in front. An Italian inscription is visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: The Decapitated
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 12.9 × 18.2 cm (5 1/16 × 7 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows soldiers in armor surrounding a decapitated figure. The scene includes soldiers with helmets, the decapitated body holding its own head, two armored figures interacting with it, a row of tents, marching soldiers in the distance, and a sky with radiating lines.

artworks.title: The Hangman
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.2 × 8.6 cm (5 3/16 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an execution scene with a kneeling figure on a raised wooden platform. An axe-wielding individual stands nearby. Surrounding them are helmeted figures with polearms, along with additional spectators. In the background, there are tents and hills with a distant settlement.

artworks.title: Knight of Malta
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.1 × 8.3 cm (5 3/16 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with several figures and an inscription. The composition shows figures in armor and robes within a dramatic setting, suggesting a moment of confrontation or decision. In the center, an armored figure stands near a flame, interacting with other figures in different poses. Architectural elements like columns and large blocks define the background. The scene also includes a seated figure on a platform, gesturing towards the other figures. The detailed linework and hatching create depth and texture in the drawing.

artworks.title: Giovanni Fieschi
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8.2 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two mounted figures engaged in combat amidst a scene filled with soldiers. The two central figures, both armored and on horseback, are in a dynamic interaction, with one wielding a lance. Their horses are depicted in motion. In the background, a large number of soldiers holding long pikes are seen. The style suggests a classical or historical theme, with fine detail in the depiction of textures. The text below the image is in Italian. The overall composition captures a moment of tension and movement.

artworks.title: Hercule d'Este
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13.3 × 8 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of armored figures on horseback engaged in battle. The scene includes two armored knights on horses in dynamic motion. The foreground rider is displaying a shield and is clashing with another horseman. The horses are depicted with detailed musculature. Surrounding them are spears held by unseen figures, adding intensity to the setting. The style of the drawing is reminiscent of detailed line engravings from the Renaissance period, focusing on intricate line work to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: Queen of Cyprus
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 15 × 8.1 cm (5 7/8 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a central figure standing with her arms outstretched and gazing upward. She has long curly hair, delicate facial features, and is wearing a flowing gown with gathered sleeves, a belt, and an intricate necklace. In front of her on the ground are a crown and a rosary. Surrounding her are multiple figures, mainly women, dressed in similar attire. To the right, a group of people are gathered on steps leading up to a throne. In the background is a large architectural structure with a celestial display of clouds and cherubic figures illuminated by light.

artworks.title: Innocent VIII
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 3.5 × 8.3 cm (1 3/8 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows several figures around a person reclining on a bed, visible from the chest up. The person on the bed is propped up by pillows and partially covered by a blanket, looking toward the other figures in the room. Around the bed, three more people are present, with one seated in a chair to the left and the others standing to the right. Above, in the upper left corner, there is a cloud-like formation with two smaller figures. The background includes architectural elements and a caption in Italian text at the bottom.

artworks.title: Bartolomeo, Farrier
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.4 × 8.1 cm (5 1/4 × 3 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a horse and a person suspended in mid-air. The drawing depicts a dynamic tableau, with a figure falling or being projected into the air near a structure wall. Two horses are below, one rearing up. Several figures are on the ground, some tending to the horses and others engaged in various activities. A dog is at the bottom right. The background features architecture like an arch and a textured wall, suggesting an urban setting. The drawing uses line work and shading to convey texture and depth.

artworks.title: The Delivered Servant
artworks.dimensions: sheet ([irreg.] trimmed to plate mark): 13 × 8 cm (5 1/8 × 3 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print depicting a woman surrounded by cherubic heads. She stands in the center of the print, looking down and to the right. She is dressed in long, draped robes, and appears to glow with radiating lines of light. Around her, in this circle of light, are the heads of five children with wings around them. The woman points downward towards a man in the bottom right corner of the print. He sits on the ground, his legs in front of him, stuck inside holes in a wooden rectangle with a lock on the side. He is looking up at the woman, his arms bent and raised up in front of him. He has short, wavy hair and a beard, and he wears a long cloth garment. The scene is set in a space with large arches on the ceiling and a barred window on the right. Below the print are some lines of text.

artworks.title: The Cured Sick Person
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 13.4 × 8.3 cm (5 1/4 × 3 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene where a bedridden figure is attended by several others. The image shows a figure lying in a canopy bed with several attendants nearby, each dressed in period clothing of historical European style. On the left, a veiled figure reaches towards the bed, holding a vessel, as another figure appears to be descending from the sky in the upper right corner. The room is elaborately decorated with drapery and furnishings that signify a setting of importance. The text at the bottom is in Italian.
